  "name": "loss_rank_gap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from a margin-based probability difference loss to directly penalizing discrepancies in relative ranking indicated by advantage signals, using a smooth tanh link to modulate penalty severity and emphasizing large ranking disagreements.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nloss_per_pair = relu(tanh(scale * diff) * rank_gap)\nweighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight\nreturn mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_constraint"
  },

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l",
      "delta_rank"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    rank_gap = batch['delta_rank']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))\n\n    diff = adv_w - adv_l\n    link = ops.tanh(scale * diff)\n    loss_per_pair = ops.relu(link * rank_gap)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_per_pair = loss_per_pair * weight\n    return loss_per_pair.mean()"
}

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    rank_gap = ops.abs(delta_rank)\n    advantage_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    x = ops.mul(scale, ops.mul(rank_gap, advantage_diff))\n    loss_per_pair = ops.sub(ops.ones_like(x), ops.tanh(x))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)\n    return loss_per_pair.mean()"

    cost_b = batch['cost_b']

    # Compute weighted difference emphasizing cost gap and log probs

        loss_l = loss_l * weight
    # Aggregate with mean

    return total_loss.mean()",

}

{
  "name": "pairwise_advantage_scaled_sigmoid_loss",
  "intuition": "Smoothly transform advantage gap with scaled tanh then sigmoid, weighted by example importance; ensures gradient flow by using differentiable ops and proper tensor requires_grad.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled = clamp(scale * adv_gap, -5, 5)\ntransformed = sigmoid(tanh(scaled))\nloss = weight * (1 - transformed)\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_advantage_transform",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap_cost_gap",
    "link_family": "sigmoid_tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "clipped_scaled"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "sigmoid",
    "clamp",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "mean",
    "ones_like"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l",
      "cost_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.5))\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    scaled = ops.clamp(ops.mul(scale, adv_gap), -5.0, 5.0)\n    transformed = ops.sigmoid(ops.tanh(scaled))\n    base_loss = ops.sub(ops.ones_like(transformed), transformed)\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weight, base_loss)\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
}

  "pseudocode": "preference_score = logsigmoid(weight * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + alpha * cost_gap); loss = -preference_score; return log(sum(exp(clamp(loss, max=50))))",

    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    alpha = float(extra.get(\"alpha\", 1.0))\n    eps = 1e-8\n    log_prob_w = batch[\"log_prob_w\"]\n    log_prob_l = batch[\"log_prob_l\"]\n    weight = batch[\"weight\"]\n    cost_gap = batch.get(\"cost_gap\", batch.get(\"cost_b\", batch.get(\"cost_a\", ops.zeros_like(log_prob_w))) - batch.get(\"cost_a\", ops.zeros_like(log_prob_w)))\n    diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)\n    input_score = ops.add(ops.mul(weight, diff), ops.mul(alpha, cost_gap))\n    preference = ops.logsigmoid(input_score)\n    loss = ops.neg(preference)\n    loss_clamped = ops.clamp(loss, max=50.0)  # clamp max to avoid infinite exp\n    exp_loss = ops.exp(loss_clamped)\n    sum_exp_loss = ops.sum(exp_loss)\n    sum_exp_loss_clamped = ops.clamp(sum_exp_loss, min=eps)\n    return ops.log(sum_exp_loss_clamped)"
}

  "intuition": "Fixed insensitivity to objective by using a weighted margin loss that explicitly increases penalty when the better candidate's log-prob is not sufficiently higher than the worse candidate's by a margin scaled by cost_gap.   "pseudocode": "diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nmargin = alpha * cost_gap\nloss_per_pair = weight * relu(margin - diff)\nloss = mean(loss_per_pair)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "preference",
    "signal_family": "pairwise_signals",
    "link_family": "hinge",
    "agg_family": "pairwise_aggregation",

  "operators_used": [

  "implementation_hint": {

    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    alpha = float(extra.get(\"alpha\", 1.0))\n    log_prob_w = batch[\"log_prob_w\"]\n    log_prob_l = batch[\"log_prob_l\"]\n    cost_gap = batch[\"cost_gap\"]\n    weight = batch[\"weight\"]\n\n    diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l  # the higher the better\n    margin = alpha * cost_gap\n    hinge_loss = ops.relu(margin - diff)\n    loss = ops.mean(hinge_loss * weight)\n    return loss",

  "name": "loss_pairwise_advantage_tanh_relu_scaled_shifted",
  "intuition": "Fixed the issue by adding a shift parameter to the advantage gap before scaling and applying tanh to better handle negative values and reduce zeroing out from ReLU.   "pseudocode": "adv = advantage_w - advantage_l\nshift = -0.5\nscaled_adv = scale * (adv + shift)\ntransformed = relu(tanh(scaled_adv))\nloss = weight * (1 - transformed)\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {

    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh_relu_shifted_scaled",

    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {

      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 3.0))\n    shift = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('shift', -0.5))\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    shifted = ops.add(adv_gap, shift)\n    scaled = ops.mul(shifted, scale)\n    transformed = ops.relu(ops.tanh(scaled))\n    loss = ops.mul(weight, ops.sub(ops.ones_like(transformed), transformed))\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "pseudocode": "adv = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled_adv = scale * adv\nexp_pos = exp(scaled_adv)\nexp_neg = exp(-scaled_adv)\nnormalized = exp_pos / (exp_pos + exp_neg)\nclipped = clamp(normalized, 0, 1)\nloss = weight * (1 - clipped)\nreturn mean(loss)",

}

  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based and rank-based paradigms to directly penalizing the difference of sigmoid activations of log probability differences weighted by the delta regret signal, safely clamping and ensuring numeric stability.",
  "pseudocode": "sig_w = sigmoid(log_prob_w)\nsig_l = sigmoid(log_prob_l)\ndiff = sig_w - sig_l\nweighted_diff = diff * delta_regret * weight\nloss = mean(clamp(-weighted_diff, 0, 1))",

      "weight",
      "delta_regret"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    lpw = batch[\"log_prob_w\"]\n    lpl = batch[\"log_prob_l\"]\n    weight = batch.get(\"weight\", ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    delta_regret = batch[\"delta_regret\"]\n    sig_w = ops.sigmoid(lpw)\n    sig_l = ops.sigmoid(lpl)\n    diff = ops.sub(sig_w, sig_l)  # difference of confidence scores\n    weighted_diff = ops.mul(diff, delta_regret)\n    weighted_diff = ops.mul(weighted_diff, weight)\n    loss_per_pair = ops.clamp(ops.neg(weighted_diff), 0.0, 1.0)\n    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)"

  "pseudocode": "diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\npreference = logsigmoid(diff + alpha * advantage_gap)\nloss_raw = -preference * weight\nloss = sum(loss_raw) / sum(weight + reversed_weight)",

  ],

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch['weight']\n    adv_gap = batch.get('advantage_gap', ops.zeros_like(lpw))\n\n    diff = lpw - lpl\n    preference = ops.logsigmoid(diff + alpha * adv_gap)\n    loss_raw = -preference * weight\n\n    # Compute symmetric weights by summing weights of pairs reversed\n    # For simplicity assume batches are ordered so reversing pairs is feasible via roll\n    reversed_weight = ops.roll(weight, shifts=1)\n    total_weight = weight + reversed_weight\n    # Normalize loss by sum of symmetric weights\n    weighted_sum = ops.sum(loss_raw)\n    norm = ops.sum(total_weight) + 1e-8\n\n    return weighted_sum / norm\n"
}

  "intuition": "Fixed missing implementation_hint.expects by explicitly listing all batch keys used in the loss. Added 'weight' to expects since it is conditionally used. Kept normalization of difference to stabilize numerical range and clamping to avoid large logits. Used 'cost_gap' as the quality signal per requirement, ensuring it is detached to prevent backprop through it, preserving computations as stable and semantically consistent for pairwise preference learning.",
  "implementation_hint": {
    "mode": "pairwise",
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "cost_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    alpha = float(extra.get("alpha", 1.0))
    log_prob_w = batch["log_prob_w"]
    log_prob_l = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch.get("weight", None)
    cost_gap = batch["cost_gap"].detach()
    diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
    eps = 1e-8
    norm = ops.sqrt(ops.mean(ops.square(diff)) + eps)
    normalized_diff = diff / norm
    scaled_diff = alpha * 1.9496803035382082 * normalized_diff - 0.1 * cost_gap
    x = ops.clamp(scaled_diff, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = loss * weight
    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "stable_pairwise_preference_loss_with_advantage_gap",
  "intuition": "To improve numerical stability and ensure clear preference semantics, this loss uses advantage_gap as the objective signal, which typically centers around zero and can reduce scale issues. The difference in log probabilities is clamped elementwise to [-10, 10] to prevent extreme logits that cause instability in the logistic function. The result is a stable, smooth logistic loss aligned with the advantage signal, encouraging correct ranking with robust gradients.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = clamp(log_prob_w - log_prob_l, -10, 10); preference = logsigmoid(weight * diff + alpha * advantage_gap); loss = -preference; return mean(loss)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    alpha = float(extra.get(\"alpha\", 1.0))\n    log_prob_w = batch[\"log_prob_w\"]\n    log_prob_l = batch[\"log_prob_l\"]\n    weight = batch[\"weight\"]\n    advantage_gap = batch[\"advantage_gap\"]\n    diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)\n    diff_clamped = ops.clamp(diff, -10.0, 10.0)\n    logits = ops.add(ops.mul(weight, diff_clamped), ops.mul(alpha, advantage_gap))\n    preference = ops.logsigmoid(logits)\n    loss = ops.neg(preference)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"

{
  "name": "pairwise_preference_loss_with_symmetry",
  "intuition": "Inject a symmetry constraint to ensure that preference scores are consistent and invariant when swapping preferred and non-preferred options; this stabilizes training by enforcing that the loss behaves oppositely but equivalently under reversal, improving fairness and numerical stability.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l + alpha * cost_gap; preference = logsigmoid(diff); symmetrical_preference = (preference - logsigmoid(-diff)) / 2; loss = -mean(weight * symmetrical_preference)",
  "hyperparams": {

      "cost_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    alpha = float(extra.get(\"alpha\", 1.0))\n    log_prob_w = batch[\"log_prob_w\"]\n    log_prob_l = batch[\"log_prob_l\"]\n    weight = batch[\"weight\"]\n    cost_gap = batch.get(\"cost_gap\", ops.zeros_like(log_prob_w))\n    diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l + alpha * cost_gap\n    pref_pos = ops.logsigmoid(diff)\n    pref_neg = ops.logsigmoid(ops.neg(diff))\n    symmetrical_pref = ops.div(ops.sub(pref_pos, pref_neg), 2.0)\n    loss = -ops.mean(ops.mul(weight, symmetrical_pref))\n    return loss"
}

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    scale = extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.5)\n    scale_tensor = lpw.new_full((), scale)\n    scale_clamped = ops.clamp(scale_tensor, 0.5, 1.5)\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    transformed = ops.relu(ops.tanh(ops.mul(scale_clamped, adv_gap)))\n    abs_adv = ops.abs(adv_gap)\n    logits = ops.mul(abs_adv, weight)\n    weight_norm = ops.softmax(logits, dim=0)\n    loss = ops.mul(weight_norm, ops.sub(ops.ones_like(transformed), transformed))\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}
